intro: A Torn Journal Page is a tattered piece of parchment recovered from an old shipping crate along the Stormwind City canals. It serves as an essential physical clue into the identity and dark history of Stalvan Mistmantle, connecting the grim happenings in Duskwood to records preserved in Elwynn Forest.

p: Discovered hidden near the bottom of a sealed storage crate beside Stormwind City's canals—tucked beneath old books, family heirlooms, and a ceramic vase—this fragment was left behind among forgotten personal effects. Though damaged and worn, the handwriting upon the page carries a distinct script that points directly to Stalvan Mistmantle's past, prompting investigators to seek out those who might still recognize the hand that penned it.
